title: Fishing Rods in Nebula?

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
no, It is not needed. If players want to have fishing rods then they can craft it themselves by finding string(cobweb on rendezvous for example)
and We don't want to have fishing rods. It makes unfair gameplay PVP wise and is annoying. All the players who can't use it against someone who can use it will be unfair



SO THE ANSWER IS NO!

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body: In my opinion, fishing rods are unnecessary for loadouts, since it would be a lot more annoying than bowspam. Also, if a player uses it correctly, they have the ability to knock others off the map really easily, which would be horrible for gameplay.

replies.author: _Phyre
replies.body: Tbh, If you're an MCSG player or Hive, whatever. Fishing rods are BEYOND useful, now a lot of people will disagree, and I totally see why, Its not what they are used to, its basically like bringing flint and steel as a "tryhard" thing on avicus. My answer is no, if the map creator wants you to have Fishing rods, they will most likely put cobweb and wood in the map. So thats just my opinion. :P
